name: orca-pixel-office
description: Launch and manage a Pixel Agents office for all Orca-managed agents.

interface.shortDescription: Visualize Orca-managed agents in a pixel office.
interface.longDescription: Starts the Pixel Agents runtime, opens its office in Orca, and connects the lifecycle of all Orca-managed agents through a single Orca event adapter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open and manage the Pixel Office for the current Orca workspace.
